Forme juridique de l'attributaire Le marché public sera conclu : – soit avec un opérateur économique unique ; 8/17 – soit avec un groupement d’opérateurs économiques conjoint ou solidaire. En cas de groupement conjoint, le mandataire sera solidaire, pour l'exécution du marché public, de chacun des membres du groupement, pour ses obligations contractuelles à l'égard de l’acheteur. La composition du groupement ne peut être modifiée entre la remise des offres et la date de signature du contrat. 2-6. ant indiquant qu'il ne tombe pas sous le coup d'une interdiction de soumissionner. La notification du marché public emporte acceptation du sous-traitant et agrément des conditions de paiement. Les prestations de services sont prouvées par des attestations du destinataire ou, à défaut, par une déclaration de l'opérateur économique ; • Une déclaration indiquant les effectifs moyens annuels du candidat et l'importance du personnel d'encadrement pendant les trois dernières années ; • Une description de l'outillage, du matériel et de l'équipement technique dont le candidat disposera pour la réalisation du marché public. Dans ce cas, il est également demandé de fournir dans le pli une copie de l’intégralité de la candidature et de l’offre sur support électronique (Clé USB, CD, DVD…). 6.1.5 - Signature des documents Le pouvoir adjudicateur a décidé d e privilégier une signature électronique pour la finalisation du contrat ! La signature électronique est exigée pour les pièces suivantes : - Lettre de candidature (DC1) ; - Acte d’engagement (AE). Les pièces transmises et pour lesquelles une signature est exigée peuvent être revêtues de la signature électronique sécurisée dès le dépôt de l’offre , en utilisant un certificat de signature électronique. Ce certificat doit être délivré par une autorité de certification accréditée et permettre de faire le lien entre une personne physique et le document signé électroniquement. Les candidats, qui auront choisi de ne pas signer les pièces de l’offre (pour lesquelles une signature est exigée) lors de leur dépôt, sont informés que l’attribution du marché donnera systématiquement lieu à la signature électronique de ces dernières. references_experience.text: (MVVM) development pattern, where you would have to code the presentation layer by creating View Models and Views for each object you wish to display, using NOF there is only a set of default generic (MVVM) views defined by NOF and they are applied to all domain objects (models). The Naked Objects pattern was first described formally in Richard Pawson's PhD thesis which includes a thorough investigation of various antecedents and inspirations for the pattern including, for example, the Morphic user interface. Naked Objects is commonly contrasted with the model-view-controller pattern. However, the published version of Pawson's thesis (see References) contains a foreword by Trygve Reenskaug, who first formulated the model-view-controller pattern, suggesting that Naked Objects is closer to the original intent of model-view-controller than many of the subsequent interpretations and implementations. Further information on the NO pattern is available at http://www.nakedobjects.org/ . Naked Objects 2.0 The BOMi currently uses version 2.0 of the Naked Objects framework, referred to as 'NOF2', which was the first publicly available framework to implement the 'naked objects pattern'. NOF2 was originally written by Naked Objects Group and supplied to the Department under an open-source licence.

Fixture scripts can also be used within the running application, facilitating manual/exploratory testing (discussed below). The Department also provides a number of other libraries to manage fixtures. The simple “fake data” library can be used in unit and other tests to select/generate a random value for use within a test. Integration tests should not hard-code any officer user Ids, instead the “officer leasing” library allows an unused user/officer account to be exclusively used, with logic to automatically check/reset the officer’s certificates for signed recorded actions. Production code should never use system time directly, instead it should be possible to “mock the clock” in tests. For the BOMi application the “Programmable Clock” service provides this capability. Keeping Tests Green Whenever a project starts the Department will ensure that the initial CI pipeline for their project branch (of the Trunk) is green. B2B: The DSP API and Electronic Exchange of Social Security Information (EESSI) APIs enable business-to-business integration to other Departments, public service bodies and to other European countries. Other supporting systems that make up the technology landscape include Facial Imaging Matching System (FIMS), and the General Registers Office (GRO) system. The BOMi’s scope will continue to grow in both size and complexity to (a) support the Department’s expanding Digital requirements, (b) consolidate its technology stack, and (c) continue to support new or changing legislation as it arises. The current technology platform is .NET Framework 4.x deployed to Windows Servers. In due course these will be upgraded to .NET 6 (aka .NET Core) at which time the Department will plan to deploy these systems, either for testing and/or production, on Linux/Docker when appropriate. New systems also target .NET 6 for the same purpose. The Department’s development resources are a combination of the Department’s internal staff, partnering with a number of service providers. The Senior Technical Development Advisor (TDA Lot 1) has acted as an independent strategic technical advisor across the IS Division, providing guidance on a range of SDLC and architecture related concerns. The TDA (Lot 1) helped product and platform teams deliver secure, resilient, and high-quality solutions more rapidly through the adoption of modern engineering practices and automation technologies. The TDA (Lot 1) role focused on shaping governance process and technical direction and procurement activities, translating complex technical issues into clear recommendations and implementation plans. Key areas of contribution included Continuous Integration, Release and Deployment, SDLC platform engineering, application security process and governance, Test Data Management modernisation, Developer Experience, contract testing, and SDLC platform architecture, particularly for the Department’s BOMi Platform. The TDA (Lot 1) also played a significant role in defining product and platform ownership models, associated team charters and enhanced IT governance approaches. In addition, the role supported various technical procurements through technical assessments.

We ensure that Ireland's environment is protected, and we monitor changes in environmental trends to detect early warning signs of neglect or deterioration. Protecting our environment is a huge responsibility, and we work with a number of organisations that carry out specific environmental functions. As of August 2014, we are also responsible for ensuring that the people of Ireland are protected from the harmful effects of radiation. This commitment is reflected in our own activities through an Environmental Management System (EMS), certified to ISO 14001 since 2010, which supports good environmental management in our everyday operations. The EPA is an independent public body established under the Environmental Protection Agency Act, 1992. Our strategy sets a clear pathway to achieve net zero emissions in a way that supports our customers and ensures ESB’s continued growth. ESB are committed to leading the transition to a reliable and affordable net zero future. ESB seeks to purchase supplies, services and works that are produced or delivered in a manner that has the most positive environmental, social and economic impacts possible over their entire lifecycle. ESB procurement processes will be aligned with the standards from ISO20400, Sustainable Procurement. ESB have created a Sustainability Leadership Plan which sets out our ambitions and the actions we will take as they relate to the three pillars of sustainability - People, Planet and Place. Full details of ESB’s Sustainability Leadership Plan can be viewed here: ESB Sustainable Leadership Plan. ESB requires that the successful Contractor emerging from the Procurement process be familiar with our Sustainable Leadership Plan. ESB is a founding member of the Irish Supply Chain Sustainability School. The school’s aim is to support and develop skills and knowledge in sustainability in the built environment. Further

The supplier will be expected to provide a structured and transparent development methodology, supported by appropriate governance, project management, universal design principles including accessibility, quality assurance and stakeholder engagement processes. It is proposed that the Framework will include (non-exhaustive list – high level scope): Create engaging, accessible and effective digital learning that keeps learner needs, content and learning objectives central to the design. Ensure all interactive elements are accessible, usable and support diverse learner needs, undertaking additional development where required to meet accessibility requirements. Undertake accessibility testing as part of the design, development and quality assurance process, using appropriate testing methods and tools, and remediate identified accessibility issues prior to final delivery and approval. deliverables_scope.text: ie/who-we-are/about-esb A.1.1 General Description of the Proposed Contract The Contracting Entity intends to procure a Digital Learning Design, Development and Maintenance Services framework for the provision of specialist digital learning services, including instructional design, eLearning development, accessibility reviews, project management and associated support services. The successful tenderer will be required to work collaboratively with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) and stakeholders to design, develop, review, test and deliver digital learning content from initial onboarding through to final approval and provision of SCORM-compliant outputs. The supplier will be expected to provide a structured and transparent development methodology, supported by appropriate governance, project management, universal design principles including accessibility, quality assurance and stakeholder engagement processes. It is proposed that the Framework will include (non-exhaustive list – high level scope): Create engaging, accessible and effective digital learning that keeps learner needs, content and learning objectives central to the design. Wenn der Lieferant sich auch beim Einreichen von Offerten vertreten lassen will, muss er für jeden Auftrag dem externen Vertreter eine Vollmacht erteilen. Diese Vollmacht ist der Offerte beizufügen. Ein Lieferant möchte auf die Mittel einer anderen Wirtschaftseinheit zurückgreifen (wie im Königlichen Erlass vom 18. Juni 2017, Artikel 72§1, vorgesehen). Ein Lieferant kann einen Qualifizierungsantrag stellen und für die Qualifizierungskriterien, die Anforderungen in Bezug auf die wirtschaftliche, finanzielle oder technische Leistungsfähigkeit sowie berufliche Befähigung enthalten (3.3.2 und 3.3.3), die Kapazitäten anderer Wirtschaftseinheiten in Anspruch nehmen. Mit anderer Wirtschaftseinheit ist eine andere (natürliche oder juristische) Person als der Lieferant selbst gemeint. Möchte ein Lieferant die Mittel einer anderen Wirtschaftseinheit in Anspruch nehmen, so gibt er dies in der Frage in Teil II C der EEE an. Möchte ein Lieferant die Mittel einer anderen Wirtschaftseinheit in Anspruch nehmen, so muss er zusätzlich zu einer EEE diese Wirtschaftseinheit veranlassen, den Abschnitt „Leistungsfähigkeit Dritter“ in Anhang 3 auszufüllen. Ohne diese Anlage kann der Lieferant eine solche Leistungsfähigkeit nicht in Anspruch nehmen. Unter Punkt 2 des Fragebogens in Anlage 1 muss angegeben werden, für welchen Teil des Auftrags diese Leistungsfähigkeit in Anspruch genommen wird. Duration of a supplier’s qualification A supplier's qualification is valid for a term of 5 years. After the 5-year period, the qualification may be extended for the same period after the administrative and/or technical files are updated. Infrabel Procurement sends the supplier an invitation in this regard about 6 months before the qualification's expiry date. The supplier shall submit the new administrative and/or technical file within 2 months. If the supplier does not take timely action, it runs the risk that its qualification extension is not completed before expiry date. Infrabel reserves the right to perform an audit, if this is deemed necessary, before extending the qualification. If these updated files and possible audit show that the supplier still meets the qualification conditions/criteria, the qualification of the supplier concerned will be renewed. The qualified supplier must continue to meet all qualification conditions/criteria throughout the qualification period. Krachtens artikel 42, §2 van het KB Plaatsing is het in deze fase van de procedure niet noodzakelijk dat de aanvraag tot deelneming elektronisch wordt ondertekend. Het is evenwel aangewezen om dit wel te doen. Indien de kandidaat ervoor kiest de aanvraag tot deelneming elektronisch te ondertekenen, gebeurt deze ondertekening op het indieningsrapport van het e-Procurementplatform. Het is niet vereist elk afzonderlijk document individueel digitaal te ondertekenen. De ondertekening kan op globale wijze gebeuren via het indieningsrapport. De elektronische handtekening op het indieningsrapport dient een gekwalificeerde elektronische handtekening te zijn die uitgaat van een bevoegd of gemachtigd persoon (of personen). Indien de kandidaat de aanvraag tot deelneming elektronisch heeft ondertekend, hoeft het Uniform Europees Aanbestedingsdocument (UEA) niet opnieuw te worden toegevoegd bij de indiening van de definitieve offerte. Een kandidaat mag slechts één aanvraag tot deelneming indienen (indien ingediend wordt als hoofdaannemer of lid van een consortium). 5.1 Capacité de tiers Sauf pour les conditions de sélection pour lesquelles il est requis ci-après que le Candidat (ou les membres du Groupement) y satisfasse « en propre » /par lui-même, le Candidat peut invoquer la capacité de tiers 6 pour répondre aux conditions de capacité financière et techniques qui suivent, pour autant que ce tiers :  Soit identifié dans le formulaire de Candidature et dans le DUME du Candidat ;  Ne se trouve pas en situation d’exclusion au sens des articles 67 à 70 de la Loi du 17 juin 2016 (voir point 4 ci-avant) ;  S’engage à mettre à disposition du Pouvoir adjudicateur ses capacités pendant toute la durée du Marché, ce qui suppose, pour les exigences de capacité technique, que le tiers s’engage à exécuter les travaux pour lesquels ses références de marchés similaires ou son agréation sont invoquées. A cette fin, le tiers :  Complète et signe le DUME (parties I, II, III et IV) tel que formaté par le Pouvoir adjudicateur et disponible sur « e-procurement » qui est joint à la candidature ;  Signe et complète les déclarations d’engagement de sous-traitance suivant le modèle en annexe, qui sont jointes à la Candidature. Functionally, the Education and Research Specialist will serve as the core technical anchor for Component 1 and Component 2 execution, collaborating closely with the Policy Specialist, M&E Specialist, and country networks to translate empirical evidence into actionable, system-wide basic education policy reforms across the six participating member states (Angola, Comoros, Ethiopia, Madagascar, Malawi, and Mozambique).

Website Hosting & Support Service The objective of this tender process is to invite proposals for the provision of website hosting, ongoing maintenance and development services for the CORU website. Tenderers shall demonstrate their capability to provide a secure, reliable, and resilient hosting environment that supports the continued availability and performance of the website. Particular consideration will be given to: • The location of the hosting infrastructure and the suitability of the hosting arrangement from a regulatory, operational, and data governance perspective. • The provision of secure and user -friendly content management functionality that enables authorised CORU staff to undertake routine and moderate website content updates without requiring specialist technical support. • The implementation of appropriate security controls, monitoring, and maintenance processes to protect the website from unauthorised access, modification, disruption, or malicious activi

sla_onsite.text: CORU's operational, regulatory and strategic requirements. 3.3 Key Requirements Of The Website Hosting & Support Service 1. Website Migration Services The successful tenderer shall be responsible for the migration of CORU's existing live website to the proposed hosting environment. The migration service shall include, at a minimum: • Development and execution of a detailed migration plan, including timelines, responsibilities, testing and implementation activities. • Migration of all website content, functionality, configurations and associated assets to the proposed environment. • Measures to minimise disruption to website availability and user experience during the migration process. • Comprehensive testing prior to go -live, including functional, security, performance, accessibility and user acceptance testing. • Provision of rollback and recovery procedures in the event of migration issues. • Preservation of existing search engine rankings and implementation of any necessary redirects and SEO protections during migration. • Post-migration support to address any issues arising following implementation. Be fully supported and regularly updated by the provider and software vendor. 9 2. Hosting Services The successful tenderer shall provide a managed hosting service for the CORU website. The proposed hosting solution shall: • Be hosted within the European Union, with hosting in Ireland preferred. • Be secure, resilient and scalable. • Support high availability and business continuity requirements. Include proactive monitoring and management of the hosting environment. • Include automated notifications and alerting for outages, service degradation, security incidents or attempted attacks. • Maintain a minimum service availability commitment of 99.9% excluding agreed scheduled maintenance periods. Tenderers shall provide details of: • Hosting location(s). • Primary and secondary hosting facilities and data centres. • Backup arrangements and retention periods. • Disaster recovery arrangements. Tarkvaraarendaja peab omama kogemust Drupali-põhiste veebilahenduste arendamisel või liidestamisel ning vähemalt ühe kaasaegse JavaScripti raamistikuga (nt React, Angular või Vue.js) töötamisel. Tarkvaraarendaja peab omama teadmisi ja praktilist kogemust WCAG 2.2 AA ligipääsetavusnõuete rakendamisel veebiarenduses. Testija: vastutab kvaliteedikontrolli ja testimise eest (võib olla kombineeritud disaineri või projektijuhi rolliga). Pakkuja peab pakkumises esitama meeskonnaliikmete nimed ja rollid ning iga rolli kohta CV Lisa 6 vormil. Meeskonnaliikmeid võib hankelepingu täitmise ajal vahetada, kuid sellest tuleb hankijat eelnevalt teavitada. Asendav meeskonnaliige peab vastama vähemalt samadele nõuetele, mis olid esitatud asendatavale liikmele. Kogu projektiga seotud suhtlus, dokumentatsioon ja aruandlus peavad toimuma eesti keeles. Lähtekoodi kommentaarid ja tehniline dokumentatsioon koostatakse inglise keeles. Lisaks pakkumuses nimetatud meeskonna liikmetele võib tekkida vajadus kaasata hankelepingu täitmisel täiendavaid spetsialiste. Aims and Objectives The Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) is designed to facilitate ease of access for conducting the training services without the need to submit a full commercial proposal. Admission to the DPS will be made on the basis of the Applicant’s capacity, as evidenced by a combination of turnover (financial and economic standing) and previous experience (technical and professional ability). The DPS lends itself to the dynamic nature of the Procurement Consultancy Services industry, allowing Economic Operators to apply, or re-apply, for admission to the DPS at any stage during its Term. 3.3. For the avoidance of doubt, the final Systems Audit Report shall be submitted not later than six (6) months following the end of the financial year under review. The Systems Audit shall include, but not be limited to, a review of the billing system environment, billing processes and controls, user access management, segregation of duties, data integrity, billing accuracy, tariff configuration controls, customer account management controls, billing adjustments and exception handling procedures, revenue assurance controls, interface controls between systems, audit trails, change management procedures, reporting controls, business continuity arrangements, backup and recovery procedures, and compliance with applicable policies, procedures and regulatory requirements. The Contractor shall assess the adequacy, effectiveness and reliability of the controls in place and identify any weaknesses, risks or areas for improvement. The Contractor shall submit a Systems Audit Report detailing findings, risks, recommendations, proposed corrective actions and, where appropriate, prioritisation of recommendations based on their significance and potential impact. insurance_bonds.text: EMENT OF OBJECTIVES (SOO) For Secure by-Design Space Vehicle (SDSV) Topic Area 3 1.0 Purpose The objective of this effort is to address cyber threats to national critical space missions (e.g., Position, Navigation, and Timing (PNT), Missile Warning/Missile Tracking (MW/MT), Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR), and Satellite Communications (SATCOM)) through the research, design, development, testing, and demonstration of a comprehensive Secure by-Design Space Vehicle (SDSV) system. 2.0 Background Space vehicles are increasingly recognized as vulnerable platforms facing sophisticated cyber threats. To ensure mission assurance, there is a critical need to provide advanced defensive solutions for space assets. This project aims to reduce the attack surfaces of space vehicles and implement robust resiliency mechanisms that enable self-protection and rapid recovery from cyber anomalies, leveraging Cyber-Hardened Satellite Software (CHSS) technology. 3.0 Period and Place of Performance • Period of Performance: The anticipated period of performance is a 12-month Base effort, followed by three (3) 12-month Option periods, plus 3 months for final reporting (Total 51 Months). • Place of Performance: The work will be performed primarily at the contractors facilit

Equal treatment principle has to apply to all the stages of the tendering procedure and not only from the time when a supplier submits a tender. Οι τεχνικές προδιαγραφές τόσο του Κέντρου Δεδομένων όσο και των υπηρεσιών περιγράφονται στο Έντυπο 9 - ΠΙΝΑΚΑΣ ΠΡΟΣΦΟΡΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΣΥΜΜΟΡΦΩΣΗΣ. Η λύση θα υποστηρίζει τη συνεχή αναπαραγωγή (replication) των επιλεγμένων εικονικών μηχανών του Πανεπιστημίου προς το περιβάλλον του Αναδόχου, με χρήση του λογισμικού Veeam Backup and Replication, ώστε να διασφαλίζεται η δυνατότητα ανάκτησης των κρίσιμων πληροφοριακών συστημάτων σε περίπτωση σοβαρής διακοπής λειτουργίας ή καταστροφής του κύριου Κέντρου Δεδομένων του Πανεπιστημίου Κύπρου. Στόχος είναι η συνέχιση της παροχής υπηρεσιών μέσω διαδικτύου προς την Πανεπιστημιακή κοινότητα και το κοινό, με τον ελάχιστο δυνατό χρόνο διακοπής. Η λύση θα πρέπει να παρέχει τη δυνατότητα ενεργοποίησης (failover) των επιλεγμένων εικονικών μηχανών στο περιβάλλον του Αναδόχου όταν και εφόσον κριθεί αναγκαίο, καθώς και δυνατότητα ασφαλούς επαναφοράς (failback) στο κύριο Κέντρο Δεδομένων του Πανεπιστημίου μετά την αποκατάσταση

ουσας Αρχής. Κατά τη διάρκεια της επίσκεψης, τα άτομα της Αναθέτουσας Αρχής θα έχουν συναντήσεις με τους αρμόδιους μηχανικούς του DR Datacenter και θα παρουσιαστούν η υποδομή και η αρχιτεκτονική του χώρου, οι μηχανισμοί πλεονασμού και διαθεσιμότητας, καθώς και οι διαδικασίες Disaster Recovery. Παράλληλα, θα παρουσιαστούν οι διαδικασίες replication, failover/failback και αποκατάστασης των συστημάτων σε περίπτωση καταστροφής ή διακοπής λειτουργίας. Ο Ανάδοχος πρέπει να συμπεριλάβει στην προσφορά του όλα τα τυχών έξοδα για την επίσκεψη (κόστος μεταφοράς, διαμονής, γεύματα κτλ.). Παραμετροποίηση Υπηρεσίας Disaster Recovery: VMware as a service, Veeam Configuration, initial replication Διαμόρφωση των μηχανισμών replication μέσω του λογισμικού Veeam, της εφαρμογής των απαιτούμενων πολιτικών προστασίας, καθώς και της ασφαλούς διασύνδεσης με την υφιστάμενη υποδομή του Πανεπιστημίου, σύμφωνα με τη Μελέτη Εφαρμογής. Υλοποίηση της αρχικής αντιγραφής των δεδομένων και των επιλεγμένων εικονικών μηχανών από το κύριο κέντρο δεδομένων προς το περιβάλλον DR. Περιλαμβάνεται η ρύθμιση των μηχανισμών replication, ο έλεγχος της ορθής μεταφοράς των δεδομένων και λειτουργίας και η επιβεβαίωση της ετοιμότητας του περιβάλλοντος για ενεργοποίηση σε περίπτωση καταστροφής. All fakturering til Harstad kommune og samarbeidskommuner som inngår i kontrakten, må gjennomføres i Elektronisk Handels Format (EHF). Godkjente standardformater er EHF fakturering versjon 3.0 eller nyere og PEPPOL BIS (PEPPOL Business Interoperability Specification) Billing v3.0 eller nyere. Dette dokumentet omfatter bestemmelser om hvordan elektronisk fakturering gjennomføres for Harstad kommune med samarbeidskommuner, i EHF-formatet. Dokumentet beskriver kun de spesifikke informasjonselementene kommunene sender og har behov for å motta fra leverandøren. Obligatorisk innhold i EHF3.0 omhandles ikke i denne spesifikasjonen, slik som virksomhetsadresser, mva. håndtering, kontoopplysninger og lignende. For en mer omfattende veiledning for Elektronisk Handels Format (EHF) v3.0, se: Elektronisk Handelsformat - EHF - Prosessdefinisjoner | Anskaffelser.no Spesifikasjon av felter og innhold er i

Der Verbraucherzentrale Bundesverband ist die Stimme der Verbraucher:innen – und damit eine entscheidende Kraft in der Politik. Wir wissen, was Verbraucher:innen bewegt und verschaffen ihnen Gehör bei Politik, Wirtschaft und Verwaltung. Strukturelle Missstände decken wir auf, benennen Verbraucherprobleme und entwickeln Lösungen. So tragen wir dazu bei, dass Märkte transparent und gerecht gestaltet werden. II. Ausgangslage Zur Selbstdarstellung und zur Unterstützung der politischen Interessenvertretung veröffentlicht der Verbraucherzentrale Bundesverband regelmäßig zahlreiche Kommunikationsmaterialien. Dazu zählen Publikationen, Social-Media-Grafiken, Flyer, Visuals für Veranstaltungen und Kampagnen sowie digi- tale Formate. Im Juli 2025 wurde die neue Marke Verbraucherzentrale mit einem überarbeiteten Corporate Design eingeführt. Grundlage hierfür ist die strategische Positionierung der Marke Verbraucherzentrale. Das neue Corporate Design setzt klare und verbindliche Gestaltungsstandards für die Kommunikation und unterstützt einen einheitlichen, zeit

ung. So können auch kurzfristige oder zeitkritische Projekte zuverläs- sig umgesetzt werden. Ziel der Ausschreibung ist daher der Abschluss eines Rahmenvertrags für Grafikleistungen mit zwei Losen. III. Laufzeit und Umfang des Rahmenver- trags Die zu schließenden Verträge für Grafikleistungen (Los I und Los II) haben eine Laufzeit vom 01.01.2027 bis 31.12.2028. references_experience.text: Tout manquement sera sanctionné. Les produits échantillonnés devront être présentés tels qu’ils seront livrés en cours d’exécution du marché. Les étiquettes de chaque échantillon devront être conformes aux exigences du présent marché. Au cas où il existerait un désaccord entre les spécifications annoncées et celles relevées sur les échantillons, c'est toujours la formule la plus avantageuse pour le client qui sera retenue pour devenir base contractuelle du marché. Les cartons de livraison porteront obligatoirement le nom du candidat avec la mention « ECHANTILLONS MARCHE CROUS ». Il sera accompagné d’un bon de livraison détaillé précisant la référence et/ou la marque de chaque produit, ainsi que les fiches techniques de l’ensemble des échantillons. Le défaut de présentation des documents exigés (étiquettes, bon de livraison, fiches techniques) entraînera également le rejet de l’offre. Il est rappelé que les échantillons demandés, ainsi que les précisions apportées dans l'offre par les fiches techniques, constitueront la définition contractuelle des produits retenus. Tous les échantillons remis par les candidats, retenus ou non, restent acquis à l’établissement. references_experience.text: (MVVM) development pattern, where you would have to code the presentation layer by creating View Models and Views for each object you wish to display, using NOF there is only a set of default generic (MVVM) views defined by NOF and they are applied to all domain objects (models). The Naked Objects pattern was first described formally in Richard Pawson's PhD thesis which includes a thorough investigation of various antecedents and inspirations for the pattern including, for example, the Morphic user interface. Naked Objects is commonly contrasted with the model-view-controller pattern. However, the published version of Pawson's thesis (see References) contains a foreword by Trygve Reenskaug, who first formulated the model-view-controller pattern, suggesting that Naked Objects is closer to the original intent of model-view-controller than many of the subsequent interpretations and implementations. Further information on the NO pattern is available at http://www.nakedobjects.org/ . Naked Objects 2.0 The BOMi currently uses version 2.0 of the Naked Objects framework, referred to as 'NOF2', which was the first publicly available framework to implement the 'naked objects pattern'. NOF2 was originally written by Naked Objects Group and supplied to the Department under an open-source licence.

Fixture scripts can also be used within the running application, facilitating manual/exploratory testing (discussed below). The Department also provides a number of other libraries to manage fixtures. The simple “fake data” library can be used in unit and other tests to select/generate a random value for use within a test. Integration tests should not hard-code any officer user Ids, instead the “officer leasing” library allows an unused user/officer account to be exclusively used, with logic to automatically check/reset the officer’s certificates for signed recorded actions. Production code should never use system time directly, instead it should be possible to “mock the clock” in tests. For the BOMi application the “Programmable Clock” service provides this capability. Keeping Tests Green Whenever a project starts the Department will ensure that the initial CI pipeline for their project branch (of the Trunk) is green. The TDA (Lot 1) helped product and platform teams deliver secure, resilient, and high-quality solutions more rapidly through the adoption of modern engineering practices and automation technologies. The TDA (Lot 1) role focused on shaping governance process and technical direction and procurement activities, translating complex technical issues into clear recommendations and implementation plans. The TDA (Lot 1) also played a significant role in defining product and platform ownership models, associated team charters and enhanced IT governance approaches. As of August 2014, we are also responsible for ensuring that the people of Ireland are protected from the harmful effects of radiation. ESB are committed to leading the transition to a reliable and affordable net zero future. ESB seeks to purchase supplies, services and works that are produced or delivered in a manner that has the most positive environmental, social and economic impacts possible over their entire lifecycle. ESB procurement processes will be aligned with the standards from ISO20400, Sustainable Procurement. ESB have created a Sustainability Leadership Plan which sets out our ambitions and the actions we will take as they relate to the three pillars of sustainability - People, Planet and Place. Full details of ESB’s Sustainability Leadership Plan can be viewed here: ESB Sustainable Leadership Plan. certifications_partner.text: s strategy, ‘Driven to Make a Difference: Achieving Net Zero by 2040’ includes a clear direction to take action and exercise leadership in sustainability. Our strategy sets a clear pathway to achieve net zero emissions in a way that supports our customers and ensures ESB’s continued growth. ESB are committed to leading the transition to a reliable and affordable net zero future. ESB seeks to purchase supplies, services and works that are produced or delivered in a manner that has the most positive environmental, social and economic impacts possible over their entire lifecycle. In addition, ESB extracts further value at certain points along this chain: supplying gas, using our networks to carry fibre for telecommunications, developing electric vehicle public charging infrastructure and more. ESB is a leading Irish utility focused on providing excellent customer service and maintaining our financial strength. We have a regulated asset base of approximately €12 billion with 30% of electricity generation capacity in the all-island market.

Die Parteien sind sich darüber einig, dass die vertragsgegenständliche Leistung während der Vertragslaufzeit fehlerfrei zur Verfügung zu stellen ist. D. h. insbesondere, dass – insofern der Auftragnehmer Updates seiner eingesetzten Datenbanklösung vornimmt und soweit vom Auftragnehmer zu 2 von 7 beeinflussen – nach der Durchführung von Updates sämtliche nach diesem Vertrag geschuldeten Leistungen, Module, Funktionen und Designelemente der TMB weiterhin zur Verfügung stehen. 4. Der Auftragnehmer räumt der TMB mit vollständiger Bezahlung des jeweiligen Arbeitspaketes das ausschließliche Recht ein, die entsprechenden Ergebnisse des jeweiligen Arbeitspaketes des Auftrages einschließlich der Arbeits- und Berichtsunterlagen ohne die Mitwirkun

ndlage stellt die vorliegende Leistungsbeschreibung mit allen Anlagen in Verbindung mit dem Kostenangebot zur Ausschreibung dar. 2. Die Arbeitspakete 1 und 2 werden mit der Zuschlagserteilung unmittelbar beauftragt. 3. Die Arbeitspakete 3-8 werden durch Einzelabrufe entweder vollumfänglich (Arbeitspaket 5), jährlich oder halbjährlich (Arbeitspakete 3, 4, 6) oder auf Stundenbasis (Arbeitspakete 7, 8) beauftragt. 4. Sollten sich aus der Umsetzung einzelner Arbeitspakete für die folgenden Arbeitspakete Änderungsbedarfe ergeben, kann einvernehmlich von den Vertragspartnern eine Anpassung des Leistungsumfangs innerhalb des vorgesehenen Budgetrahmens vorgenommen werden. 5. Der Auftragnehmer hat die Vorgaben der TMB in Bezug auf den Vertragsgegenstand zu beachten. 6. Der Auftragnehmer bzw. die in seinem Auftrag arbeitenden Unternehmen führen alle Leistungen unter Beachtung der gesetzlichen Vorschriften aus. 7. rund der gelieferten Inhalte entstehen, einschließlich der Kosten der Inanspruchnahme rechtsanwaltlicher Hilfe. 5 von 7 V. Ausführungszeit / Abnahme 1. Mit der Abgabe eines Angebots durch den Auftragnehmer garantiert dieser eine Bearbeitung der Arbeitspakete 1 und 2 unmittelbar nach der Erteilung des Zuschlags. 2. Alle weiteren Ausführungszeiten werden zwischen den Vertragsparteien einvernehmlich abgestimmt. Grundlage für diese einvernehmliche Abstimmung ist das Preisblatt, dass die zeitlichen Abhängigkeiten der Arbeitspakete determiniert. 3. Für nicht datenschutzbezogene Ansprüche verweist der Auftraggeber hingegen auf Ziffer 19 der EVB-IT Cloud-AGB. § 11 Abs. 2 und 3 des AVV sieht insbesondere eine Freistellung des Auf- traggebers sowie den Ersatz aller Schäden vor, die auf eine schuldhafte Ver- letzung datenschutzrechtlicher Pflichten durch den Auftragnehmer zurück- zuführen sind; eine betragsmäßige Haftungsobergrenze ist dort nicht vorge- sehen. Eine betragsmäßig unbeschränkte Haftung führt zu einem für den Bieter nur eingeschränkt kalkulierbaren wirtschaftlichen Risiko. Eine angemessene Haftungsbegrenzung schafft demgegenüber eine transparente und kalkulier- bare Grundlage für die Angebotsabgabe. Dieser Ansatz entspricht auch der Argumentation der beigefügten Mustervorlage auf das 1,5-fache Brutto-Ge- samtauftragswert. Daher bitten wir Sie, für jeden Bieter und bei Bietergemeinschaften für jedes Mitglied der Bietergemeinschaft die folgenden Daten der Eigenerklärung auszufüllen und mit dem Angebot, im Fall vorgelagerter teilnehmerwettbewerbe mit dem Antrag auf Teilnahme am Teilnahmewettbewerb einzureichen. Nationale Identifikationsnummer Wir bitten um Angabe der Wirtschafts-Identifikationsnummer für Unternehmen und andere Wirtschaftsteilnehmer. Da diese noch nicht vorliegt, ist eine andere eindeutige Identifikationsnummer, wie die Umsatzsteuer-ID (bevorzugt) oder ein Registereintrag (z. B. Handelsregistereintrag in Deutschland) anzugeben. Für natürliche Personen kann aus datenschutzrechtlichen Gründen kein Eintrag erfolgen. Dann ist „kein Eintrag“ vorzugeben. Nationalität des Eigentümers Wenn das beauftragte Unternehmen nicht börsennotiert ist, muss die Angabe der Nationalität des wirtschaftlichen Eigentümers verpflichtend erfolgen. Das Unternehmen ist □ börsennotiert □ nicht börsennotiert, weiter mit Angabe der Staatsangehörigkeit Wir bitten um Angabe der Staatsangehörigkei

Duration of a supplier’s qualification A supplier's qualification is valid for a term of 5 years. After the 5-year period, the qualification may be extended for the same period after the administrative and/or technical files are updated. Infrabel Procurement sends the supplier an invitation in this regard about 6 months before the qualification's expiry date. The supplier shall submit the new administrative and/or technical file within 2 months. If the supplier does not take timely action, it runs the risk that its qualification extension is not completed before expiry date. Infrabel reserves the right to perform an audit, if this is deemed necessary, before extending the qualification. If these updated files and possible audit show that the supplier still meets the qualification conditions/criteria, the qualification of the supplier concerned will be renewed. The qualified supplier must continue to meet all qualification conditions/criteria throughout the qualification period. Een kandidaat mag slechts één aanvraag tot deelneming indienen (indien ingediend wordt als hoofdaannemer of lid van een consortium). Een onderaannemer kan wel onderaannemer zijn voor verschillende offertes. Bestek nr. 16E

Objective of this Request for Tender The objective of this RFT is to appoint a digital partner to support the ongoing maintenance, hosting, optimisation, enhancement and if and where necessary, development of the Skillnet Ireland digital ecosystem, comprising the corporate website (www.skillnetireland.ie), and, if and when relevant, associated campaign landing pages, microsites, analytics infrastructure and any additional Skillnet Ireland-owned web properties that may be developed or maintained during the contract period. Testija: vastutab kvaliteedikontrolli ja testimise eest (võib olla kombineeritud disaineri või projektijuhi rolliga). Meeskonnaliikmeid võib hankelepingu täitmise ajal vahetada, kuid sellest tuleb hankijat eelnevalt teavitada. Asendav meeskonnaliige peab vastama vähemalt samadele nõuetele, mis olid esitatud asendatavale liikmele. Kogu projektiga seotud suhtlus, dokumentatsioon ja aruandlus peavad toimuma eesti keeles. Lähtekoodi kommentaarid ja tehniline dokumentatsioon koostatakse inglise keeles. The Sizing Technology Pilot is a direct extension of this modernization mandate, seeking to apply advanced digital, computer vision, and AI-driven measurement extraction capabilities to a fundamental logistical process: Soldier and Cadet outfitting. The Army is exploring a Sizing Technology Pilot to modernize the Soldier and Cadet outfitting process by using body scanning, foot scanning, computer vision, and/or AI- driven measurement extraction to generate accurate measurements and translate them into recommended uniform and footwear sizing. This capability is intended to support personnel earlier in the accessions pipeline than is possible today, in support of a faster, more consistent, and more accurate issue experience. The scope of this requirement encompasses both body and foot scanning to modernize the issuance of both uniforms and footwear. The scope covers four primary initial accession pipelines: (1) Initial Entry Training (IET) Soldiers processing through Military Entrance Processing Stations (MEPS); (2) United States Military Academy (West Point) Cadets; (3) contracted Senior Reserve Officers' Training Co

y initial accession pipelines: (1) Initial Entry Training (IET) Soldiers processing through Military Entrance Processing Stations (MEPS); (2) United States Military Academy (West Point) Cadets; (3) contracted Senior Reserve Officers' Training Corps (ROTC) Cadets at civilian host institutions nationwide; and (4) In-service Soldiers for pre-deployment equipment issue; and the ability to update Soldiers’ data over time in a wide spectrum of environments. 2. ielding, and deployment preparations. For the avoidance of doubt, the final Systems Audit Report shall be submitted not later than six (6) months following the end of the financial year under review. The Systems Audit shall include, but not be limited to, a review of the billing system environment, billing processes and controls, user access management, segregation of duties, data integrity, billing accuracy, tariff configuration controls, customer account management controls, billing adjustments and exception handling procedures, revenue assurance controls, interface controls between systems, audit trails, change management procedures, reporting controls, business continuity arrangements, backup and recovery procedures, and compliance with applicable policies, procedures and regulatory requirements. The Contractor shall assess the adequacy, effectiveness and reliability of the controls in place and identify any weaknesses, risks or areas for improvement. entity_geography.text: Development Activities 1.2.2.1 Invitation to Advance to Phase 2: Prototype Development The objective of Phase 2 is to continue the R&D efforts of the proposed solution from Phase 1 with the goal of developing, testing and delivering a prototype to Canada for the selected Challenge. Small Businesses that have completed their Phase 1 contract and where the innovation remains of interest to Canada may receive an invitation, by way of a request for documentation, to advance to Phase 2 at the sole discretion of Canada. There is no minimum TRL level for a Phase 1 innovation to advance to Phase 2. Small businesses must still meet the Eligibility Criteria in 1.4 and must provide all documentation outlined in Attachment 3 when requested. A request for documentation does not guarantee that a Phase 2 contract will be awarded. Small businesses should not have any expectations of being invited to advance to Phase 2. In other words, there is no guarantee of participation in Phase 2. Canada will not provide justifications to small businesses as to why an innovation was not selected to participate in Phase 2. 1.2.2.2 Advancement into Testing Stream: Prototype Testing The objective of the Testing Stream is to procure, test and evaluate R&D pre-commercial goods and services in

forward with further research and development, however, small businesses may be matched with another Government of Canada Organization under the Testing Stream. entity_geography.text: σε πιστοποιημένο Κέντρο Δεδομένων επιπέδου Tier III, για 3 έτη, με δικαίωμα προαίρεσης για ακόμα 2 έτη. Στο αντικείμενο της σύμβασης περιλαμβάνεται η παροχή της απαιτούμενης υποδομής VMware, των αναγκαίων υπολογιστικών, αποθηκευτικών και δικτυακών πόρων, καθώς και η εγκατάσταση, παραμετροποίηση και λειτουργία της υπηρεσίας Disaster Recovery. Οι τεχνικές προδιαγραφές τόσο του Κέντρου Δεδομένων όσο και των υπηρεσιών περιγράφονται στο Έντυπο 9 - ΠΙΝΑΚΑΣ ΠΡΟΣΦΟΡΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΣΥΜΜΟΡΦΩΣΗΣ. Η λύση θα υποστηρίζει τη συνεχή αναπαραγωγή (replication) των επιλεγμένων εικονικών μηχανών του Πανεπιστημίου προς το περιβάλλον του Αναδόχου, με χρήση του λογισμικού Veeam Backup and Replication, ώστε να διασφαλίζεται η δυνατότητα ανάκτησης των κρίσιμων πληροφοριακών συστημάτων σε περίπτωση σοβαρής διακοπής λειτουργίας ή καταστροφής του κύριου Κέντρου Δεδομένων του Πανεπιστημίου Κύπρου. Στόχος είναι η συνέχιση της παροχής υπηρεσιών μέσω διαδικτύου προς την Πανεπιστημιακή κοινότητα και το κοινό, με τον ελάχιστο δυνατό χρόνο διακοπής. Η λύση θα πρέπει να παρέχει τη δυνατότητα ενεργοποίησης (failover) των επιλεγμένων εικονικών μηχανών στο περιβάλλον του Αναδόχου όταν και εφόσον κριθεί αναγκαίο, καθώς και δυνατότητα ασφαλούς επαναφοράς (failback) στο κύριο Κέντρο Δεδομένων του Πανεπιστημίου μετά την αποκατάσταση

ουσας Αρχής. Κατά τη διάρκεια της επίσκεψης, τα άτομα της Αναθέτουσας Αρχής θα έχουν συναντήσεις με τους αρμόδιους μηχανικούς του DR Datacenter και θα παρουσιαστούν η υποδομή και η αρχιτεκτονική του χώρου, οι μηχανισμοί πλεονασμού και διαθεσιμότητας, καθώς και οι διαδικασίες Disaster Recovery. Παράλληλα, θα παρουσιαστούν οι διαδικασίες replication, failover/failback και αποκατάστασης των συστημάτων σε περίπτωση καταστροφής ή διακοπής λειτουργίας. Ο Ανάδοχος πρέπει να συμπεριλάβει στην προσφορά του όλα τα τυχών έξοδα για την επίσκεψη (κόστος μεταφοράς, διαμονής, γεύματα κτλ.). Παραμετροποίηση Υπηρεσίας Disaster Recovery: VMware as a service, Veeam Configuration, initial replication Διαμόρφωση των μηχανισμών replication μέσω του λογισμικού Veeam, της εφαρμογής των απαιτούμενων πολιτικών προστασίας, καθώς και της ασφαλούς διασύνδεσης με την υφιστάμενη υποδομή του Πανεπιστημίου, σύμφωνα με τη Μελέτη Εφαρμογής. Υλοποίηση της αρχικής αντιγραφής των δεδομένων και των επιλεγμένων εικονικών μηχανών από το κύριο κέντρο δεδομένων προς το περιβάλλον DR. Περιλαμβάνεται η ρύθμιση των μηχανισμών replication, ο έλεγχος της ορθής μεταφοράς των δεδομένων και λειτουργίας και η επιβεβαίωση της ετοιμότητας του περιβάλλοντος για ενεργοποίηση σε περίπτωση καταστροφής. deliverables_scope.text: ..................... ................................ ........ 6 6 Kreditering ................................ ................................ ................................ ..... 6 1 Krav om elektronisk fakturering I medhold av Forskrift om elektronisk faktura i offentlige anskaffelser (2.april 2019) er EHF faktura obligatorisk ved fakturering til kommunene. All fakturering til Harstad kommune og samarbeidskommuner som inngår i kontrakten, må gjennomføres i Elektronisk Handels Format (EHF). Godkjente standardformater er EHF fakturering versjon 3.0 eller nyere og PEPPOL BIS (PEPPOL Business Interoperability Specification) Billing v3.0 eller nyere. Dette dokumentet omfatter bestemmelser om hvordan elektronisk fakturering gjennomføres for Harstad kommune med samarbeidskommuner, i EHF-formatet. Dokumentet beskriver kun de spesifikke informasjonselementene kommunene sender og har behov for å motta fra leverandøren. Obligatorisk innhold i EHF3.0 omhandles ikke i denne spesifikasjonen, slik som virksomhetsadresser, mva. håndtering, kontoopplysninger og lignende. For en mer omfattende veiledning for Elektronisk Handels Format (EHF) v3.0, se: Elektronisk Handelsformat - EHF - Prosessdefinisjoner | Anskaffelser.no Spesifikasjon av felter og innhold er i
